I am 52, farmed 30 years. My 8 mu: 5 mu wheat-maize, 2 mu cotton, 1 mu watermelon. Seven people at home, two sons work in Shijiazhuang and send maybe 5,000 yuan a year, but I pay for the inputs myself.

For winter wheat on 5 mu: Last year I put one 50-kilogram bag of compound fertilizer per mu before planting. At green-up I spread 25 kilograms of urea per mu. That cost about 170 yuan per mu and gave me 500 kilograms per mu. This year I will do the same — one bag compound, 25 kilograms urea. I irrigate three times: after planting if dry, at green-up, and at jointing. I spray twice — herbicide once, and one insecticide when the aphids come. I rotary till before planting. Improved seeds, about 15 kilograms per mu.

For summer maize on the same 5 mu: After wheat harvest in June, I have only a few days — I plant no-tillage. I use 40-kilogram bags of compound fertilizer, one bag per mu, because I can carry them faster to the field. Then at big trumpet I add 20 kilograms urea per mu. Two irrigations: one after planting if no rain, one at flowering. Two sprays: herbicide and one for corn borer. Hybrid seeds, 2.5 kilograms per mu. Last year I got 550 kilograms per mu, this year I expect the same.

For cotton on 2 mu: I plough deep in April because cotton roots need soft soil down deep. Bt hybrid seeds, 1 kilogram per mu. One 50-kilogram bag of compound per mu, plus 15 kilograms of potassium fertilizer because the dealer said cotton needs it for the bolls, and his cotton looked good last year. Then 15 kilograms urea at flowering. Three irrigations: seedling, flowering, and boll stage. Three pesticide sprays — I don't fully trust the Bt cotton, I still spray when I see bollworms. Expected 250 kilograms of seed cotton per mu.

For watermelon on 1 mu: I rotary till and make ridges. Hybrid seeds from the shop. One bag of compound per mu, plus 25 kilograms potassium fertilizer — watermelon needs that for sweetness, my cousin who grows melon told me that. Also 10 kilograms urea. Six irrigations, small amounts each time, never flood the melon. Four sprays for the leaf fungus and aphids. If market price is good, 3,500 kilograms per mu. This mu costs the most per mu, but it's only one mu so I manage.

I think about my total money. Fertilizer for all crops costs me about 2,400 yuan this year. Pesticide is another 600 yuan. I do the spraying myself with the backpack sprayer to save labor cost. I would rather put a little too much fertilizer than risk a bad harvest — if wheat fails, I have no grain for the family. So I copy what worked last year, I watch Lao Zhang's fields and Auntie Wang's fields, and if their wheat looks greener than mine I ask what they used.
